999008199.text: あった。これだこれ

localizations.en: Found it! This is exactly what we need!

999008199.text: これが、探してた素材？

localizations.en: Is this the material you were looking for?

999008199.text:
そう。採取するのに一番苦労しそうなやつ。
これが手に入れば、成功したも同然だよ

localizations.en: That's right. This was going to be the hardest one to gather. With this in hand, success is practically guaranteed!

999008199.text: ここまではるばる来た甲斐があったね

localizations.en: Looks like coming all this way paid off!

999008199.text: うん！　これもみんなのおかげ――

localizations.en: Yeah! And it's all thanks to everyone—

999008199.text: えっ
ふっ！
な、なにっ！？　魔物の襲撃！？
あーあ。護衛さんたちはやっぱり隙がないなぁ

localizations.en: Well, well. These guards really are as sharp as they say.

999008199.text:
シトリン！？　なんでアンタがここに！？
まさか、後をつけてきたの？

localizations.en: Citrine!? What are you doing here!? Don't tell me you followed us!

999008199.text: どうだっていいさ、そんなことは

それより、君のほうが問題だろう？
教えに背いて、こんなところまでやって来るなんて

localizations.en: More importantly, aren't you the one with some explaining to do? Coming all the way out here, defying your teachings...

999008199.text: それも「錬金術」に必要なのかい？
はて、錬金術とな？

localizations.en: Alchemy, you say? Whatever could you mean?

999008199.text:
とぼけても無駄だよ。君が錬金術とやらを使って、
水不足を解消しようと動いてるのは知ってる

localizations.en: Playing dumb won't help. I know you're planning to use alchemy to solve the water shortage.

999008199.text: ちっ……やっぱり面倒な奴

localizations.en: Tch... what a pain in the neck.

999008199.text:
それで？　アタシを心配して、
わざわざ注意しに来てくれたってこと？

localizations.en: So? Did you come all this way just to warn me out of the kindness of your heart?

999008199.text:
注意？　違う違う。
僕は奪いに来たのさ。君が持っている案ってヤツをね

localizations.en: A warning? No, no. I'm here to take that little solution of yours.

999008199.text:
この話は、僕にとっても重要な商機なんだ。
みすみす逃すわけにはいかないよ

localizations.en: This situation represents an important business opportunity for me. I can't just let it slip away.

999008199.text:
いーやいやいや、だからって商売がたきを襲って
横取りなんて、まともじゃないでしょ！？

localizations.en: Oh come ON! Attacking your competition to steal their work? That's just not right!

999008199.text:
あんたはヤな奴だけど、そういう一線は越えないと
思ってた。見損なったよ！

localizations.en: I knew you were sketchy, but I thought you had SOME standards! I guess I was wrong about you!

999008199.text:
君にどう思われようが、別に構わないね！
アルビーナ・ジムロック！！

localizations.en: I couldn't care less what you think of me! Alvina Zimlock!!

999008199.text: 神聖国で働く者同士で争うなんて……

localizations.en: To think fellow servants of Nova would come to blows...

999008199.text:
僕だって最強の聖戦士と戦いたくはないよ。
でも、商売だから！

localizations.en: Trust me, I'd rather not fight Nova's strongest Holy Warrior. But business is business!

999008199.text:
ヤンネさん！
そんなこと言ってる場合じゃないですって！

localizations.en: Lady Janne! This is no time to be philosophical!

999008199.text:
大人しく情報を渡してくれたら、
悪いようにはしないんだけどな

localizations.en: If you'd just hand over the information quietly, I promise no harm will come to you.

999008199.text: 情報を渡した時点で最悪なんですけど！

localizations.en: Handing over the information would BE the harm!

999008199.text:
思ったよりしぶといなあ。
さっさと終わらせたいんだけど

localizations.en: You're more stubborn than I expected. I'd like to wrap this up quickly...

999008199.text: ……それはお互いさま
さあて、どっちが先に倒れるかね

localizations.en: Well then, let's see who drops first!
